Name: Diblaim
Summary: Diblaim is named only as the father of Gomer, Hosea's wife (Hosea 1:3). Nothing else is told of him.
KeyStory: Diblaim's only mention is as the father of Gomer, whom Hosea married at God's command.
LifeLesson: Diblaim's single verse is enough to place him in the story. God remembers fathers whose only recorded act is a daughter He wove into prophecy.
